## HN Morning Brief
Hourly (or `curl localhost:5678/webhook/hn-brief`).
1. Algolia: front page → **top 5 by points**
2. Official HN API: **live score + top comment**
3. IF #1 ≥ 500 pts → "big story" header
4. Post to Discord (credential, no secrets in nodes)

### Error paths
• Front-page fetch: 3 tries → error output → Discord alert
• Enrichment: continue on fail → digest still sent, marked ⚠️
• Discord: 3 tries → "Delivered?" check → log → Stop and Error (execution fails visibly → crash alert)
• Anything else → Error Trigger → crash alert
